segments.speaker: Marvin the Martian
segments.text: I was just getting ready to test my latest weapon, the PR-200. A very practical tool which reduces any living species to one-tenth of its normal size. For the experiment, I enlisted the help of a devoted member of my army. I was just about ready to test my invention, when suddenly an invader smashed into my water tank at full speed, and the whole tank collapsed all over my army.

segments.speaker: Marvin the Martian
segments.text: Drat! An invader smashed into my water tank at full speed, and the tank spilled on my entire army.

segments.speaker: Marvin the Martian
segments.text: The accursed invader looked like a black sheep.

segments.speaker: Marvin the Martian
segments.text: Wait, I haven't finished yet. My army is still incomplete. A somewhat rebellious unit has gotten themselves into a sticky situation and it's risky to get them out. I, Marvin the Martian, don't plan on taking any unnecessary risks.

segments.speaker: Marvin the Martian
segments.text: It was utter chaos, but after a super Martian effort, and the help of my fantastic PR-200, I managed to get back most of my army. Isn't that delightful?

segments.speaker: Marvin the Martian
segments.text: It's up to you to repair the damage now, by returning to me my lost instant Martians.

segments.speaker: Marvin the Martian
segments.text: Well done. As promised, I'm going to take you back to Earth.
